commit_message:
[WebGPU] Preserve Wasm host pointer widths (#25075)

I hit this while running JAX → IREE → WebGPU inside JupyterLite with
wasm64.

The WebGPU bridge passes host pointers as uint32_t and reads pointer
tables assuming four-byte entries. This truncates wasm64 addresses and
misreads multi-block instruction streams.

Use uintptr_t for host pointers and handle their width in JavaScript.
GPU handles and instruction words remain 32-bit. This also handles
signed wasm32 pointers above 2 GiB correctly.
Validates this for wasm32/wasm64.

Signed-off-by: anutosh491 <andersonbhat491@gmail.com>
name: samples
